config.label: Base URL of the ntfy server, e
config.description: Base URL of the ntfy server, e.g. https://ntfy.example.net. There is deliberately no default.

config.label: ntfy access token (tk_
config.description: ntfy access token (tk_...). Optional: an open instance needs no credentials. Mutually exclusive with NTFY_USERNAME/NTFY_PASSWORD.

config.label: Username for basic authentication
config.description: Username for basic authentication. Must be set together with NTFY_PASSWORD.

config.label: Password for basic authentication
config.description: Password for basic authentication. Must be set together with NTFY_USERNAME.

config.label: Comma-separated topics the server may use
config.description: Comma-separated topics the server may use. The first is the default when a tool omits one, and the list restricts every read and write tool.

config.label: Set to exactly true to register only the six read tools (default: false — ntfy exists to publish)
config.description: Set to exactly true to register only the six read tools (default: false — ntfy exists to publish)

config.label: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate from the ntfy server (default: false)
config.description: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate from the ntfy server (default: false)

config.label: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)
config.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)

config.label: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever the allow list left
